title: Baseband File Reader
text: Read baseband signals from file, 2 outputs; {Baseband file name} sets the name of baseband file, {Inherit sample time from file} selects source of sample time, {Sample time (s)} sets the block sample time, {Samples per frame} sets the number of samples per output frame, {Repeatedly read the file} sets the continuously loop data from file and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Baseband file name
params.values: Name of baseband file to read example.bb (default) | character vector

params.name: Inherit sample time from file
params.values: Select source of sample time on (default) | off

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Number of samples per output frame 100 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Repeatedly read the file
params.values: Continuously loop data from file off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
